title: Altitude's Toll
description:
Altitude's Toll is a short single-player walking simulator mystery set in Himalayas.IntroductionMatt, a 27 year old sherpa, is solving a mystery with his dispatcher about a magnetic repulsion in Himalayas. The dispatcher is thinking about leaving the job as it isn't fulfilling enough; on the other hand, Matt is enjoying it...
...until something unsettling happens on his final ascend.

Content• Pretty and colorful nature

• Slow immersive gameplay

• Wildlife reacts to the players presence

• Delivering packages

• Handmade level design

• Explorable world

Playtime 30-60 minutes
description_short: Altitude's Toll is a short walking simulator mystery set in Himalayas. Deliver packages as sherpa and uncover possibly the biggest Himalayan secret in history.
